verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a tiny 'MOVIE NIGHT' chip jammed into the far-right corner, and every other line (film title, tagline, date, venue, URL) is scattered as white text straight over the busy doodle background, so none of it can be read. The headline also comes last in the reading order. B makes the same fatal mistake: the date, venue, tagline and URL are white text on the busy doodles and can't be read. Its only edge is that the small 'MOVIE NIGHT' panel sits at the left, where a banner starts reading, so it is marginally less broken; neither is usable.
